description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy - Order under Section 5
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, which constitutes a regulatory matter. It outlines specific procedures and requirements for waiving the Special Commodity Levy on imported essential goods received as donations. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
